text: Final categorization: OK (Justification: The paper is a non-review research article that explicitly implements national-scale spatial modeling for the entire island of Taiwan (35,808 km²), which the authors treat as their national study area. The primary objective is LULC prediction/simulation from 1990–2020 with projections to 2030 and 2050. It evaluates four distinct future scenarios (2-, 3-, 5-, and 6-variable combinations) with quantitative comparisons of land class changes (e.g., built-up area increasing by 223% under 6-variable scenario). The methodology uses SVM-Markov chain modeling with reported accuracy metrics (Overall Accuracy = 0.87, Kappa = 0.74 for 2020 validation). Mapped LULC projections are provided for all scenarios (Fig. 7). The study meets all core inclusion criteria and none of the exclusion criteria.)
